quotes.quote: The kid AJ that played at BYU, I'll see the Boozer twins down there at Duke. The kid that's kind of around my ways from the surrounding areas of Akron, Kent area, Darren Peterson.

quotes.speaker: Steve Nash
quotes.summary_phrase: Steve Nash on defensive transition hurting older teams
quotes.excerpt: One of the things that I also think really hurts older teams is defensive transition.
quotes.quote: One of the things that I also think really hurts older teams is defensive transition.

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James on the shift from team to individual workouts
quotes.excerpt: I don't know when that changed, that it was more beneficial to do the individual workouts.
quotes.quote: I don't know when that changed, that it was more beneficial to do the individual workouts over the five-on-five play through the summer. I don't know when the most important person in the summertime was the trainer and not the player. I know y'all are going to be like, 'Bron, we ain't seen no five-on-five clips of you lately.' Yeah, and you ain't.

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James on the 1996 NBA draft class
quotes.excerpt: Besides you guys being one of the greatest drafts of all time, is that slam cover shoot.
quotes.quote: The 96 draft, besides you guys being one of the greatest drafts of all time, is that slam cover shoot that you guys did. I had that in my room when I stayed in Spring Hills, it was on my wall with all you guys there. I remember Kobe had a cast on, right? Because he had broken his hand or some shit like that.

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James on the potential of Caleb Wilson
quotes.excerpt: I know the kid down there in North Carolina, Caleb Wilson is a dynamic player as well.
quotes.quote: I know the kid down there in North Carolina, Caleb Wilson is a dynamic player as well.

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James on players who were drafted later than expected
quotes.excerpt: Think Nikola Jokic, think Draymond Green. If you're a kid that was projected going to the second round, you become undrafted, think Austin Reaves.
quotes.quote: If you're a kid that expected to go in the first round and you don't get go in the first round, you go in the second round, think Nikola Jokic, think Draymond Green. If you're a kid that was projected going to the second round, you become undrafted, think Austin Reaves. And Wallace, Ben Wallace.

quotes.speaker: Steve Nash
quotes.summary_phrase: Steve Nash on Rick Carlisle's lineup management
quotes.excerpt: Seeing Rick Carlisle play lineups in the fourth quarter of the finals that I was like.
quotes.quote: Seeing Rick Carlisle play lineups in the fourth quarter of the finals that I was like, I think a lot of coaches would have given up on these guys. He stuck with them, he developed because he had an identity.

quotes.speaker: Steve Nash
quotes.summary_phrase: Steve Nash on the youth of the Spurs and Thunder
quotes.excerpt: The Spurs the second youngest finalists since the merger from the the ABA.
quotes.quote: The Spurs the second youngest finalists since the merger from the the ABA. And OKC last year was the third youngest ever to win.

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James on building team stamina
quotes.excerpt: Let's start early. Let's build it up, you know, but you got to have that depth.
quotes.quote: Let's start early. Let's build it up, you know, but you got to have that depth. And you got to have that youth, you know, and I think a lot of teams kind of saw what Indiana did last year. And obviously we we talked about this a long time ago in one of our episodes, it's a copycat league, man.

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James on the importance of crashing the boards
quotes.excerpt: Now, they're telling every team to crash. We shoot a lot of threes, crash to the elbows.
quotes.quote: Now, they're telling every team to crash. We shoot a lot of threes, crash to the elbows, get extra possessions.

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James on the importance of transition defense
quotes.excerpt: Ball goes up, turn and sprint, you know, and get back.
quotes.quote: Ball goes up, turn and sprint, you know, and get back. So, it can't be no in-between. And if you're the one of the oldest teams in the league, or you're one of the older teams, if you, if you crash, nine times out of ten your ass ain't going to be able to get back versus these younger teams.

quotes.speaker: Steve Nash
quotes.summary_phrase: Steve Nash on extending the NBA season
quotes.excerpt: If you don't make the playoffs, you have five months off. Should we extend the time?
quotes.quote: If you don't make the playoffs, you have five months off. Should we extend the time? Because we're never coming off this 82, it appears. Should the season be two, three, four weeks longer? Should we start in the first, second, third week of September so you have more time?

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James on the physical toll of the NBA season
quotes.excerpt: Guys are not taking much time off after the season now to get back on the court.
quotes.quote: Guys are not taking much time off after the season now to get back on the court because it's too much build up and the game is so much faster now. You can't be, you know, you used to have the ability to kind of use training camp and use like preseason to kind of get into the rhythm, you know, but now with so many, we're playing so much faster, you know, and soft tissue injuries are happening to reoccurring now that you have to start the the the body movement a lot sooner than than we maybe did back in the day.

quotes.speaker: Mahershala Ali
quotes.summary_phrase: Mahershala Ali on the transition from sports to acting
quotes.excerpt: I know I'm more of a scorer than what I'm not getting shots. Or you got to come off the bench.
quotes.quote: I know I'm more of a scorer than what I'm not getting shots. Or you got to come off the bench and be Jamal Crawford to like stay in the game.

quotes.speaker: Mahershala Ali
quotes.summary_phrase: How Dell Demps helped jumpstart my college basketball recruitment
quotes.excerpt: He got me to a camp and then I was suddenly being recruited by a bunch of schools.
quotes.quote: By the grace of God Dell Demps, former Pelicans GM, my high school alma mater saw me playing one day. He was like, 'Who's recruiting you?' And I was basically nobody was. He got me to a camp and then I was suddenly being recruited by a bunch of schools.

quotes.speaker: Mahershala Ali
quotes.summary_phrase: Playing AAU basketball alongside future NBA star Jason Kidd
quotes.excerpt: I'm playing with Jason Kidd, me and Jason are on a team and like 11 out of the 13 of our kids went D1.
quotes.quote: In the summer, I'm playing with Jason Kidd, me and Jason are on a team and like 11 out of the 13 of our kids went D1 out of that team we played against Stephen Francis and them on ESPN and all kind of stuff. So it was a good time.

quotes.speaker: Mahershala Ali
quotes.summary_phrase: Recruiting visit from Ernie Kent and his expectations for me
quotes.excerpt: Herschel, for us to be successful, your freshman year, you're going to have to average 22 points a game.
quotes.quote: Me and my grandfather are sitting there in our house and Ernie Kent comes in and he just, he had played in Oregon and he was an All-American and all that. He was a brother. I never played for a brother before other than in AAU. So I'm just like, 'I'm about to play for a black coach too. Oh snap, never had this experience.' And he goes, 'Herschel, for us to be successful, your freshman year, you're going to have to average 22 points a game.'

quotes.speaker: Mahershala Ali
quotes.summary_phrase: Mahershala Ali on his acting career and John Cho
quotes.excerpt: I recently had that with an extraordinary actor by the name of John Cho.
quotes.quote: I recently had that with an extraordinary actor by the name of John Cho. We got to do this some some work together in a film that's coming out called Your Mother, Your Mother, Your Mother. And getting to work with him was one of the real true highlights of my career. I look forward to you guys getting to see that. Him, another one I actually just I had an absolute blast was Ethan Hawke.

quotes.speaker: Steve Nash
quotes.summary_phrase: Steve Nash on Mahershala Ali's Oscar wins
quotes.excerpt: You could defend, you could shoot it. Wasn't a great shooter, but could shoot it, could slash, could play.
quotes.quote: You could defend, you could shoot it. Wasn't a great shooter, but could shoot it, could slash, could play, was kind of a combo guard and won two Oscars.
